notes.title: Brewpub Simulator opens its door in June!
notes.content:
Our publisher is announcing the release date of their new game!

Brewpub Simulator will open its doors on June 12, 2023 in a grand opening, and all of you are invited!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806433/a8058ca8accfb6f7d361370c020a0c70073cfbc9.png[/img]

The free demo is still available on the Steam page here:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1755180/Brewpub_Simulator/

There's also a competition running where you can win the full set of Movie Games' games! Sign up and win!

[url=https://gleam.io/mICoc/brewpub-simulator-contest][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806433/cf8bb2d315b90fa64924b84878e74be9623f8d1b.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Check out the Movie Games Publisher Sale!
notes.content:
Hello there!

Our publisher, Movie Games, is starting a sale with all of their titles. Total Alarm is also there, in the upcoming games section, so wishlist it too!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/sale/MovieGamesSale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806433/b923b36e77951a991148e5d070929963b6c5c05b.jpg[/img][/url]

There are thematic game bundles, big discounts (even up to -90%) and some fantastic games Movie Games partnered with. Take a look and choose something for yourself!

notes.title: Happy New Year!
notes.content:
Out with the old, in with the new! Happy New Year and let’s hope it brings us all prosperity and good fortune. May it be the best year of your life yet.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32806433/5b00ac71603050e57089e923724ea60898844063.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Happy Holidays!
notes.content:
For these upcoming holidays, we want to wish you all a time full of joy and peace. 

Much love, happiness, time spent in a family atmosphere with the smell of gingerbread and hot chocolate in the air. Thank you for being with us!
